releases.summary: Started as a documentation/project-hygiene pass; picked up an Account Details feature-and-fix pass in the same in-progress version.

entries: `TODO.md` — standing backlog of known limitations, bugs, and cleanups found during a full file-by-file review, split out of what used to be `ARCHITECTURE.MD`'s "Known Limitations / TODOs" section.
`version.md` (this file) — top-level changelog, replacing the ad-hoc "Feature pass — ..." narrative headers that used to accumulate at the top of `ARCHITECTURE.MD`.
`docs/` folder — `ARCHITECTURE.MD` split into focused per-topic files (see `ARCHITECTURE.MD` for the index). Includes a new `docs/automated-docs.md` describing the doc-generation script.

`tools/generate_docs.py` — generates `docs/generated/source-tree.md` (a file/module listing with descriptions pulled from `@brief`-style header comments) so that listing no longer has to be hand-maintained. See `docs/automated-docs.md`.

**Account Details — balance chart time-range + Y-axis controls.** Time range presets (`7D` / `1M` / `6M` / `1Y` / `From start` / `Custom`, rolling from the account's own last transaction date, `Custom` via plain `yyyy-MM-dd` fields) plus a Y-axis scale toggle: "Auto" (existing tight-fit behavior) vs. "From 0" (pins the axis minimum to 0). See `docs/account-history.md`.

**Account Details — "Income by category" / "Expenses by category" pies.** Two new 2-level nested pie charts — category ring (inner) + subcategory ring (outer), each ring its own `PieSeries` in its own `GraphsView` stacked via `anchors.fill` (not Qt Graphs' native `PieSlice` sub-slice feature — turned out to render the opposite ring order needed; and not two `PieSeries` sharing one `GraphsView` either — that made `onClicked` stop firing on both rings). Both rings' slices show labels and are independently clickable (shows "Category —"/ "Subcategory —" + amount + percentage). Income/expense is derived per-transaction from credit/debit, not a tag on `Category`. Backed by the new `AccountController::accountCategoryBreakdown(accountIndex)`. See `docs/account-history.md` and `docs/charting-gotchas.md`.

**Category prediction on statement import** — imported rows now arrive with a suggested category/subcategory and a real confidence score, learned from the user's own already- categorized transactions. No trained model and nothing persisted but the user's rules: a four-rung cascade (user rule → exact merchant key → fuzzy key → TF-IDF k-NN over word tokens and character trigrams), plus sign gating and a monthly-recurrence boost. Confidence is calibrated to the review screen's existing badge thresholds — a merchant seen once scores 0.67 (amber), twice 0.80 (green) — and drops back automatically when the user recategorizes. New `src/predict/LabelNormalizer.{h,cpp}` (merchant-key normalization — the step most of the accuracy actually comes from) and `src/predict/CategoryPredictor.{h,cpp}`. Fulfils `PROJECT.md` § Category System — Prediction. See `docs/category-prediction.md`.

**`category_rules` table + `Data::CategoryRule`** — user-authored "always categorize labels like X as Y" rules, the top rung of the cascade and the fastest-learning path in the system (one click, permanent). `src/db/tables/CategoryRulesTable.{h,cpp}` plus `Database::loadCategoryRules()` / `addCategoryRule()` (upsert, so re-teaching replaces rather than stacks) / `removeCategoryRule()`. A category-only rule (no subcategory) saves correctly.

**Import review screen — RULE column and confidence tooltips.** A `＋` per row teaches a rule from that row's merchant key and current category, then re-scores the whole statement so every other row for the same merchant snaps to it immediately. Hovering the CONFIDENCE badge explains *why* the predictor picked that category ("Categorized "EDF" as Utilities in 3 of 3 previous transactions"). The line above the table is now a live "auto-filled N of M rows" summary (`SnapshotImportController::predictionInfo`) instead of the "no model exists yet" placeholder.

**`SnapshotImportController::evaluatePredictor()`** — leave-one-out accuracy of the predictor over the user's own categorized transactions (coverage, category/pair accuracy, mean confidence, per-rung breakdown), so the tuning constants can be checked against real data instead of argued about. Backed by `Predict::CategoryPredictor::evaluate()`.

**`TransactionsTable::allCategorized()` / `Database::allCategorizedTransactions()`** — every categorized transaction across every account, oldest first; the predictor's training set. Deliberately ignores account boundaries.

**`tools/predictor_selftest.cpp`** — standalone sanity harness for `src/predict/` (build command in its header comment), covering normalization, each cascade rung, sign gating, recurrence, subcategory ambiguity and the evaluator. Not part of the CMake build — it has its own `main()`; see `TODO.md`'s "no tests" item for the Qt Test suite it stands in for.

Full CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, documented in `CI-CD.md`). Every push builds and packages the app on Windows and Linux and runs the tests and linters as independent, individually re-runnable jobs; every push to `main` publishes a GitHub release. Ships a Windows setup (`.exe`, made with Inno Setup: it asks "for me only" or "for all users", and the setup of a newer version updates an installed copy in place) and portable `.zip`, a Linux `.AppImage`, `.deb` and portable `.tar.gz`, source archives and `SHA256SUMS.txt` — none of which need Qt installed on the target machine.

`version.json` + `tools/version.py` — the version and the changelog are now one machine-readable file. `CMakeLists.txt` reads `current` straight into `project(... VERSION ...)`, so the build, the installer file names, the release tag and the app's own `setApplicationVersion()` can no longer disagree. `version.md` is generated from it (`version.py render`); log a change with `version.py add <Section> "<text>"`.

Self-contained deployment via `qt_generate_deploy_qml_app_script()` — `cmake --install` now produces a directory that runs on a machine with no Qt, and every package is cut from that one tree. Plus `packaging/` (generated app icon, `.desktop` entry, AppStream metadata, AppImage and `.deb` build scripts) and `LICENSE` (MIT), which doubles as the setup's licence page. The QML module builds into `<build>/qml/FinanceDashboard/` (`QT_QML_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY`), so it no longer takes the path of the Linux executable, which made the Linux link fail.

`tests/CMakeLists.txt` — `tools/predictor_selftest.cpp` is now a CTest target (`cmake -DFD_BUILD_TESTS=ON`, then `ctest`) instead of a hand-run binary, and CI runs it on every push. Partially clears `TODO.md`'s "no tests" item. `tests/import_save_test.cpp` (Qt Test) runs the statement-import save path end to end on a temporary database: rows without a category, subcategory or date, the reconciliation adjustment row, a category-only rule, a failed save and its retry. The app and the tests compile the same core sources (`FD_CORE_SOURCES`), and `cmake --build build --target fd_tests` builds every test.

**Docker build — build the app on any machine with only Docker installed.** `compose.yaml` + `.env` (options documented in `.env.example`: `TARGET` = `windows`/`linux`, `LINK_MODE` = `shared`/`static`, `BUILD_TYPE`, `QT_VERSION`, `LLVM_MINGW_VERSION`, job counts) + `docker/Dockerfile` (multi-stage toolchain image, one per target × link mode) + `docker/scripts/` (in-container build, packaging and static-Qt-from-source scripts) + `tools/docker-build.ps1`/`.sh` one-command wrappers. Windows is cross-compiled with llvm-mingw 17.0.6 (clang) against Qt's prebuilt `win64_llvm_mingw` 6.11.1; output goes to `dist/<target>-<mode>-<build type>/` (launcher + `app/` with exe + DLLs/plugins/qml for shared, a single executable for static). Build image is Ubuntu 22.04 (glibc 2.35, so Linux builds run on Ubuntu 22.04+/Debian 12+) with CMake from PyPI, and aqtinstall installed from a pinned master commit — the 3.3.0 release can't find Qt ≥ 6.11 Windows packages (Qt split the Windows repo per compiler: "Failed to locate XML data for Qt version '6.11.1'"), into a venv (`/opt/pytools`, with CMake) because 22.04's system pip builds it against the system setuptools 59 ("AttributeError: ignore_egg_info_in_manifest"). Static Qt sources fall back to download.qt.io's `archive/`. Also `qml/static-imports/StaticImports.qml` (static builds only: makes Qt link the Basic Controls style) and `.gitattributes` (LF for container scripts). Not yet run end-to-end. See `README.md` § Building with Docker.

**Docker build — pre-build requirement check.** `tools/check-requirements.ps1` / `.sh` (standalone, or run first by `tools/docker-build.*`): validates `.env`, Docker (installed, running, Linux containers, Compose v2, memory/disk sized for the link mode), that the Qt version / llvm-mingw release exist for the chosen target + link mode, that llvm-mingw's LLVM matches the one Qt's Windows binaries were built with (windows-shared only — static compiles Qt itself), and whether this computer can run the result (Windows build/CPU; Linux glibc/system libraries, fewer for static). New `.env` options `CHECK_REQUIREMENTS` and `FORCE_BUILD` (+ `-SkipChecks`/`-Force`, `--skip-checks`/`--force`).

**Docker build — timestamped run logs.** Every `tools/docker-build.*` run writes `logs/docker-build/<yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss>_<variant>/` with `summary.txt` (per-step result + duration), `env.txt`, `requirements.log`, `image.log`, `container.log`, and per-step `configure.log` / `build.log` / `deploy.log` from inside the container (`logs/` mounted at `/work/logs`, `RUN_LOG_DIR`). Logged output is decoded as UTF-8 and empty stderr lines no longer show up as "System.Management.Automation.RemoteException" in Windows PowerShell.

**Launcher.** Packaged builds now start through a launcher next to `app/`: `launcher/windows/main.cpp` (Win32, no Qt, statically linked — CMake target `FinanceDashboardLauncher`) and `launcher/linux/FinanceDashboard.sh`. It checks `app/requirements.txt` (generated by `deploy.py`: every packaged file, min Windows build, binaries to `ldd` on Linux), shows every requirement as OK/FAIL if something's wrong, and reports loader errors (missing DLL) the app itself can't.

**Start-up stage.** `src/startup/StartupChecks.h/.cpp`, run by `main.cpp` on every launch: requirement checks (none yet — placeholder for future ones) then initialization (data folder and database open, moved out of `main.cpp`, still non-fatal as before). A failed fatal step loads the new `qml/StartupErrorWindow.qml` (every step as met / not met + fix hint) instead of `Main.qml`.
**Removed** all `docs` for pruning and reduce overhead.
`README.md` rewritten to be a short, professional front door (what the app is, prerequisites, build/run steps).

**Account Details — transaction history table is now horizontally scrollable** instead of overflowing past the card's border on a narrow window: the header/row `Rectangle`s use a fixed `Layout.preferredWidth` and the table sits inside a `ScrollView`, which only shows a horizontal scrollbar when the card is narrower than the table.

**Account Details — all five `GraphsView`s (balance chart + both pies' inner/outer rings) use an explicit, higher-contrast `GraphsTheme`** instead of `ColorScheme.Dark` defaults, which read as too washed-out against this app's near-black cards — same Catppuccin Mocha tokens already documented in `docs/styling.md`.

**`HoverPoint.qml`'s hover hit-box enlarged (26×26 → 34×34), and its tooltip now flips below/clamps horizontally instead of always centering above the point** — the small hit-box made hovering hard to land, and always-above-centered positioning cropped the tooltip for any point near the chart's top edge or a side. Both are shared-component fixes, so they apply to every page's line-chart hover (Account Details, Savings, Cash Flow, Investments, Overview, Projects). See `docs/charting-gotchas.md`.

**Confidence badge bucketing/formatting moved from QML to C++** — `Fmt::confidenceVariant()` / `Fmt::confidenceText()` (`src/utils/Formatter.h`) replace `ImportSnapshotPage.qml`'s page-level `confidenceVariant()`/`confidenceText()` JS helpers; rows now carry ready-to-display `confidenceText`/`confidenceVariant` alongside the raw `confidence`, matching the app's "values arrive pre-formatted from the controller" convention. Clears the corresponding `TODO.md` § Convention drift item, and keeps the 0.5/0.8 thresholds next to the predictor that produces the numbers.

**`Data::ImportedTransaction` gained `predictionReason`** — one line of plain English explaining where the suggested category came from, shown as a tooltip on the confidence badge. Review-screen-only and never persisted, same status as `confidence`.

Both packaging jobs smoke-test the app before publishing: the Windows build is launched from its install tree with the real `windows` platform plugin (the tree has no `offscreen` plugin) and its setup is installed, installed again over itself and uninstalled in both install modes, the Linux `.AppImage` under Xvfb with the real `xcb` plugin, each with the builder's own Qt removed from the environment so a package that only works on the build machine fails the job.
`cmake_minimum_required` 3.20 → 3.21 (Qt's CMake deployment API), and `main.cpp` takes its version from the `FD_VERSION_STRING` compile definition instead of a hard-coded `"0.2.0"`.

**Account Details — the 3 KPI cards (Current balance / Transactions / Type-Category) are now exactly equal width and height.** Width: `Layout.fillWidth: true` alone left the middle card a hair narrower than its neighbors (QtQuick Layouts' leftover-pixel remainder handling wasn't symmetric); all three now bind an explicit, identical `Layout.preferredWidth`. Height: the Transactions card's empty `sub` line made QtQuick Layouts exclude it from the card's implicit-height calculation (a hair shorter than its two neighbors, which both have a real sub line) — now shows "All time" instead of an empty string.

**Statement import — saving works for rows without a category, subcategory or date, and a failed save writes nothing.** A null `QString` was bound as SQL `NULL` in `TEXT NOT NULL` columns, so the save failed on a first import (no predicted category), a category without a subcategory, the reconciliation adjustment row and a cleared date in the transaction editor; text and dates are now bound as `''` (`Sql::text()`, `src/db/tables/SqlText.h`). The rows, the account link and the balance checkpoints of an import now go in one SQL transaction (`Database::saveImport()`). Before, the rows written before a failing one stayed in the database, and each retry stored them again.
See `Added`/`Changed`/`Fixed` above.

`README.md` — new "Building with Docker" section (quick start, requirement check, run logs, output layout) and `docker/` + `launcher/` in the project layout. `ARCHITECTURE.MD` — build-system row and index rows for the Docker build and the start-up stage.

releases.title: Baseline
releases.summary: Starting point for this changelog. Everything below was already built before `version.md` existed; recorded here as one baseline entry rather than reconstructed commit-by-commit. Matches `CMakeLists.txt`'s `project(... VERSION 0.2.0 ...)` at the time this file was introduced.

groups.title: Navigation & shell
entries: `Main.qml` app shell: collapsible left sidebar (`SidebarCategory.qml`) + `StackLayout`, driven by a single `currentViewId` source of truth. "ADMIN" section divider above Account Management / Database Management.

Shared QML component library: `PageHeader`, `PillButton`, `GhostButton`, `StatusBadge`, `FormRow`, `ColorPickerRow`, `FormDialog`, `ConfirmDialog`, `EmptyState`, `ColumnHeaderCell`, `KpiCard`, `ChartCard`, `SidebarCategory`, `ColorComboBox`.

groups.title: Analytics pages (UI pass, mock data)
entries: Overview (net worth KPIs, stacked area by account type, allocation donut, monthly net-change bars), Cash Flow (income/expense bars, rolling average, category donut/stacked bars, biggest expenses), Savings (balance lines, ceiling/goal progress, yearly interest), Investments (portfolio vs. deposits, allocation, monthly performance), Projects (goal tracking + a real C++ annuity-math loan simulator). All five still serve `[MOCK]` data pending DB wiring.

groups.title: Transactions
entries: Statement import wizard (`ImportSnapshotPage.qml` / `SnapshotImportController`): real CSV parsing (`SumeriaCcpCsvExtractionTemplate`), editable/categorizable review table with resizable + persisted columns, account auto-match by stored hash fingerprint, parse log popup, real save to the `transactions` table.

Import report + reconciliation: post-save report (income/expense/net, category/subcategory breakdown with a pie chart), two-check balance reconciliation against declared statement balances, a mismatch-resolution dialog (review kept rows / add an adjustment transaction).
Auto-remembered balance checkpoints from every statement's declared start/end balance.
Categories & Subcategories management (add/rename/recolor/remove, SQLite-backed).
View & Edit Transactions: full per-account transaction table with colored category/ subcategory badges and an edit modal.

groups.title: Accounts & admin
entries: Manage Accounts: add/edit/remove accounts (name/type/category/currency/notes — no IBAN/BIC/account number stored), per-account hash-fingerprint management, per-account balance-checkpoint management, a routed per-account transactions view.
Account types & categories management (SQLite-backed CRUD).
Account History: read-only per-account view (current balance, balance-over-time line chart computed by replaying transactions, transaction list).
Database Management: whole-database reset (empty or reseeded with mock data) and per-account cleanup (clear transactions / delete account), all behind confirmation dialogs.

groups.title: Data layer
entries: SQLite persistence (`Database` singleton + one table class per table) for categories, subcategories, accounts, account hashes, account categories, account types, transactions, and balance checkpoints.
HMAC-SHA256 account-hash fingerprinting (`AccountHashing.h`), shared between import matching and manual account linking.

groups.title: Tooling
entries: clang-tidy (build-time opt-in + on-demand script) and qmllint (auto-wired via `qt_add_qml_module`) static analysis, plus `tools/run-static-analysis.ps1` to run both and log to `logs/`.

The original Qt Widgets app and the intermediate ported-but-unwired QML generation (`AnalyticsController`, `EntryController`, the legacy `DatabaseController`, `OverviewController`, `PortfolioController`, the legacy `ImportController`, `qml/tabs/*`) — deleted outright once nothing referenced them; recoverable from git history before this baseline if ever needed again.
Keyword-based category auto-suggestion (`CategoryKeywords.h`) — replaced by the user-managed category list.
`iban`/`bic`/`number` columns on the `accounts` table — dropped for security; accounts are now matched only via stored hash fingerprints.
